“Comrade Qu is too outstanding, I feel pressured.”

⸻
“So you’re really an adult now, huh? Alright then, while we eat, tell me more about this Dion person. If he’s going to be the first person my best friend ever dates, I should at least know who he is.”

For nearly their whole lives, they had never created this kind of separation between them. But now, it felt like something was splitting them in two. There were moments of Lane’s life Sean would no longer be able to access—not just as a best friend.
“I just wanted to mark the occasion, that’s all. I mean, this could be your first relationship.”
“Pretty sure you never told me about your first girlfriend either.”
The reply came flatly. Sean opened his mouth to respond, then shut it again. The retort rose to his throat, then sank right back down.

If being affectionate is a crime, then Na Jihan is on death row…….

122906.synopsis:
Song Zhenyan is a genius medical professor who has a Buddha-like calmness and enjoys yangsheng and drinking tea.
After suddenly dying in a violent accident, he transmigrates into a novel with six genders—
[Bad news: You share the same name with the secondary villain.] 
Song Zhenyan: What’s my mission?
System: …Your calmness scares me…
System: Your mission is to save the main villain who will end up killing you, and to promote love and peace.
“……” Song Zhenyan: “So where’s the main villain?”
The system showed him a photo: it was a sweet-faced, innocent-looking protagonist. Only Song Zhenyan knew that the monster lurking behind those eyes was the same one from his nightmares.
———
After a rational analysis, Song Zhenyan concluded that the method to reform an extreme psycho should follow these steps: minimal contact, occasional help, and most importantly: maintain a safe distance.
However, the second time he met Tong Jiannian was at his eighteenth birthday party.
The pretty boy with slightly long hair appeared in his room, suffering from severe post-differentiation complications.
The room was filled with the strong scent of wine…
A few days later, the kid who said, “I don’t need you to take responsibility,” showed up at his doorstep with a suitcase.
“Uncle Song…” Tears welled in those pitiful eyes. “They said no one wants an omega who’s been marked. I’ve been thrown out… Will you take me?”
Song Zhenyan tried to explain that he was the one who’d been bitten—
“Pling” a single tear fell from Tong Jiannian’s eye.
“……”
———
Tong Jiannian’s parents died in a car accident, and even the remaining experimental data of their [Pupil] research project was taken by an outsider.
He carefully infiltrated Song Zhenyan’s life step by step, hoping to find evidence that would make his life worse than death, but later he discovered that——
At the funeral, the one holding an umbrella for him was Song Zhenyan; the one placing flowers on the basement window was still him. He even “stole” [Pupil] to save his glands…
From the very first day Tong Jiannian moved into his house, Song Zhenyan had been waiting for the nightmare to come true.
Unexpectedly, at the engagement party plot point where the truth was revealed, Tong Jiannian not only did not hack him into pieces, but instead, flashed him with those beautiful eyes and negotiated with him, “Uncle Song, if you marry me, I will give you everything.”

132890.synopsis:
“Don’t married couples kiss every day?”
But we weren’t married.
The man in front of me was still only my fiancé.
To be exact, he was a cosmic horror wearing the skin of my dead ex-fiancé. I couldn’t fathom why such a being would choose to look like that piece of tr*sh.
“What? Ah….”
“My magic can only be purified when I touch my wife.”
Before I knew it, his lips were close, and I couldn’t escape.
As if he actually needed purification.
After the kiss, he had this habit of gently wiping my lips.
“Thanks to you, my power feels cleansed.”
Impossible. I was just an F-grade.
“My wife, from now on, we’ll be together forever.”
A cold glint flickered in his eyes.
“W-what if I die in an accident? I could die in my sleep! A heart attack or something…!”
“Then I’ll just bring you back. Even in death, you can’t leave me. Not ever.”
“…What?”
“You promised, remember? We hooked our pinkies.”
He said it as if it were nothing… something terrifying.

140058.synopsis:
“I know the Black Horse of Mount Hanchu really well! I’ve even ridden on its back! I saw its enormous horns with my very own eyes!”
A boastful little lie, told by a nameless young kitten just to survive harsh times.
But that lie got her driven out of her home. To make her words come true, the kitten, Nyang-i, set out for Mount Hanchu… only to be kidnapped nearby.
And then—what a twist!
When she came to her senses, a strikingly handsome man was caring for her. Purring away in his arms, she suddenly found herself… transformed into a human!
As it turned out, she was a mystical being capable of changing form. The handsome man, Lord Gahum, who kept calling her “Yanghee,” sweetly promised to teach her how to become human.
“If you’d stay here a little longer, I can help you.”
“My friend always said nothing in the world comes for free. Then why are you being so kind to me, Lord Gahum?”
“Because you’re my cat, Yanghee.”

142874.synopsis:
Every moment that remained in his memory was filled with Choi Taegyeom.
Choi Taegyeom was a dominant Alpha, but because of the Omegas’ excessive behavior, he especially hated them. As his childhood friend, I naturally became his only place of comfort.
“‘It’s a relief that you’re a Beta.'”
I thought it was a relief. I was satisfied with the fact that, because I was a Beta, I could stay by his side. And only later did I realize that these feelings were never the kind a friend should have.
But that winter, I manifested as an Omega.
***
“…Lee Yoonwoo?”
It felt like my breath stopped. My heart pounded helplessly at the sound of him calling my name, those three syllables. If I didn’t calm down, it felt like the remnants of emotions I had never properly put away would spill out.
“You…”
A year spent repeating school, and four years apart because of the military. After a total of five years of absence, I reunited with Choi Taegyeom.
For the first time in five years, five long years, I could feel the pheromones filling the air once again.

160026.synopsis:
Supreme Wizard was an upgrade novel that told the story of its protagonist, Meieruita, who started as the lowliest wizard apprentice and eventually rose to become the wizard standing at the pinnacle of the world.
As a novice author, An Luo wanted to grab attention, so he set the world’s background in utter darkness, with a protagonist who was utterly ruthless and cold-blooded, sparing no means to acquire knowledge.
He hammered away at the keyboard, utterly self-absorbed, convinced that he had created something massive this time and that he would surely soar to success with this book!
But when he opened his eyes, An Luo discovered that he had become the early-stage cannon fodder in his novel who tried to kill the protagonist.
Death countdown: Less than one day.
Knowing his creation better than anyone, An Luo sadly realized there was no way to escape this deadly tribulation.
Apologize? No use—Meieruita believed in an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.
Strike first and fight him head-on?
Heh, An Luo had given Meieruita the protagonist halo. How could a mere cannon fodder win? He might end up dying even more miserably.
Driven by his survival instinct, An Luo threw caution to the wind. He knocked on Meieruita’s door with a blank expression.
“Hello, you live in a novel. I’m the author. Give me 50 days of lifespan via V, and I’ll tell you the future plot developments.”
The protagonist was too terrifying; even the author himself couldn’t handle it. An Luo planned to flunk the Apprentice Exam, so when Meieruita advanced to the upper layer, he would stay put in the Lower Layer, and they could part ways forever.
“I’ve already told you all the plot,” An Luo said to Meieruita. “There’s nothing else to say. Good luck on your journey! Bye-bye.”
Meieruita looked at An Luo for a moment, then suddenly smiled softly. “You think I’m dangerous and want to stay away from me? But I think that without me by your side, you’ll die even faster.”
“Without me, you’ll be torn apart by the Thorn Beast, swallowed by the Man-Eating Flower…” Meieruita gave examples in a soft voice. “You need my protection, my dear… father.”
An Luo: “…”
Damn it, he was absolutely right!
Weak Earthlings struggled to survive in the wizard world, but the protagonist’s “kindness” was even more frightening.
An Luo knew exactly what kind of personality he had written for his protagonist!
Facing An Luo’s tension, Meieruita smiled. “Many people compare creation to childbirth.” He drew closer to An Luo. “I don’t need an authoritative father telling me what to do, but a gentle mother waiting for me at home is something to look forward to—one who can soothe my taut nerves.”
“Don’t worry,” Meieruita chuckled lowly. “I’ll protect you, my dear mother.”
“As long as you behave like a good, obedient mommy.”

Following the advice of the tiger spirit she serves, Boyoon sprays the pheromone perfume in hopes of winning Sahoon’s favor.
From that day on, her once peaceful life is turned completely upside down….
